questions.question: The greatest number which divides 1876, 12503, and 6877 leaving remainders 1, 3, and 2, respectively, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are 1876, 12503 and 6877

Remainders = 1, 3 and 2

**Concept Used:**

For this type of question we subtract remainders from the numbers and then take HCF of the resulting numbers as the greatest number.

**Calculation:**

Subtracting the remainders from the numbers we get,

1876 - 1 = 1875

12503 - 3 = 12500

6877 - 2 = 6875

Now,

HCF(1875, 12500, 6875) = 625

∴ Greatest number is 625.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A cricket club bought 12 bats and 18 balls for Rs. 2,100. After a few days, the cost of the same types of 8 bats and 22 balls purchased at the same rates was Rs. 1,900. The cost of a bat is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price of 12 bats and 18 balls is Rs. 2100.

After few days, cost price of same types of 8 bats and 22 balls is Rs. 1900.

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of 1 bat is Rs. x and cost of 1 ball is Rs. y.

According to question,

Cost Price of 12 bats and 18 balls is Rs. 2100.

⇒ 12x + 18y = 2100

⇒ 2x + 3y = 350 ............................(i)

After few days, cost price of same types of 8 bats and 22 balls is Rs. 1900.

⇒ 8x + 22y = 1900

⇒ 4x + 11y = 950 ............................(ii)

Multiply (i) by 2 and subtract from (ii), we get

⇒ 5y = 250

⇒ y = 50

Put it in (i),

⇒ x = 100

The cost of a bat is Rs. 100.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Electric energy consumed in one second is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4 ) power**__

 

Power is a physical quantity that measures the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred or converted per unit of time.

P=(W)/(t)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In (SI), the standard unit of power (P) is the watt (W).
 
• Watt (W) which is defined as one joule of energy per second.
 
• Power can be used to describe the amount of work done, energy consumed, or energy transferred per unit of time.
 
• Power can be expressed in various forms, including mechanical power, electrical power, and thermal power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **There are several different units for measuring power, depending on the context and the system of measurement being used.**

 
 

 **Watt (W)**
 The watt is the SI unit of power. It represents one joule of energy transferred or converted per second. In other words, 1 watt (W) is equal to 1 joule per second (J/s). The relationship is expressed as 1 W = 1 J/s.
 
 

 **Horsepower (hp)**
 Horsepower is a unit of power that is commonly used, especially in the context of mechanical power, particularly in the United States. The relationship between the watt and horsepower is approximately 1 horsepower (hp) is equal to 745.7 watts (W). The conversion factor may vary slightly depending on the standard used.
 
 

 **Kilowatt (kW)**
 The megawatt is an even larger unit used for very high-power applications, such as power plants. One megawatt (MW) is equal to 1,000,000 watts (W). The relationship is expressed as: 1 MW = 1,000,000 W.
 
 

 **Gigawatt (GW)**
 The gigawatt is another larger unit, often used to describe the power output of large power plants or the energy consumption of entire regions. One gigawatt (GW) is equal to 1,000,000,000 watts (W). The relationship is expressed as: 1 GW = 1,000,000,000 W.
 
 

 **Calories per Second**
 In some contexts, especially in nutrition and exercise science, power can be measured in calories per second. One calorie per second (cal/s) is approximately equal to 4.184 watts (W).
 
 

 **BTU per Hour (BTU/hr)**
 In some heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) applications, power is measured in British Thermal Units per hour (BTU/hr). One BTU per hour is roughly equal to 0.293 watts (W).
 
 

 **Megawatt (MW)**
 The megawatt is an even larger unit used for very high power applications, such as power plants. One megawatt (MW) is equal to 1,000,000 watts (W). The relationship is expressed as: 1 MW = 1,000,000 W.
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/703977903daa424f3c763dd1c3ba98d6abee6d81573b6d7edfc0e89e207cbf3f.png]

questions.question: The Supreme Court and High Courts have power to issue writs in the nature of habeas corpus, quo warranto, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition, etc., under ________.

• The writs that can be issued by the** Supreme Court and High Courts** include habeas corpus, quo warranto, mandamus, certiorari, and prohibition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Quo warranto** is a writ that can be used to **challenge the authority of a person** holding public office.
 
• **Mandamus** is a writ that can be used to compel a public official or government agency to perform a **specific duty.**
 
• **Certiorari** is a writ that can be used to review the decision of a** lower court or tribunal.**
 
• **Prohibition** is a writ that can be used to **prevent a court or tribunal **from exceeding its jurisdiction.

questions.question: An object is placed on the principal axis of a lens of power 2.0 D, at a distance of 10 cm. The image formed is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**virtual and erect**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The lens in question is a** converging lens**, also known as a** convex lens,** with a power of 2.0 D.
 
• This means that it has the ability to** converge or focus light** rays that pass through it.
 
• The object is placed on the** principal axis** of the lens, which is a line passing through the **center of curvature **of the lens and the center of the lens.
 
• This position is known as the** focal point **of the lens, and in this case, it is located 10 cm away from the lens.
 
• Since the object is located** beyond the focal point **of the lens, a** real image **is formed on the other side of the lens.
 
• The image is **inverted** because the light rays converge and cross over each other at the focal point.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virtual image** is formed when light rays appear to come from a point behind the lens.
 
• **Erect image** is formed when the object is placed between the focal point and the lens.
 
• A lens that **converges light rays** that are** parallel to its principal axis** is called a **convex lens.**
 
 
• **​**It is comparatively **narrow **at the upper and lower margins and **thick** throughout the middle.
 
• Instead of curving inside, the edges are **curled outward.**
 
• In order to shorten the focal point and ensure that the light focuses correctly on the retina, it is utilized in front of the eye to **bend incoming light** sharply.

• Pole (P/O)**: Geometric center of the spherical surface of the mirror.

questions.question: If the saving function is S = - 30 + 0.3Y, what will be the value of MPC (marginal propensity to consume)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0.7.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marginal Propensity to Consume** (MPC) is the increase in consumer spending when** disposable income increases** by one unit.
 
• In the given saving function, the formula is **S = -30 + 0.3Y,** where S is savings and Y is income.
 
• Therefore, the consumption function will be **C = Y - S.**
 
• To calculate MPC, we need to take the derivative of the consumption function with respect to income, which will be **MPC = dC/dY.**
 
• Here, **dC/dY = 1 - dS/dY.**
 
• In the given saving function, dS/dY = 0.3, so MPC will be 1 - 0.3, which is equal to 0.7.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 0.7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Based on** income level**, MPC fluctuates.
 
• MPC usually** decreases** with increasing income.
 
• The **Keynesian multiplier**, which characterizes the impact of more investment or government expenditure as an economic stimulus, has MPC as its primary factor.
 
• MPC **cannot** be **more than 1**, which means that a consumer cannot spend more than the increase in income.
 
• The marginal propensity to save is the** decrease in savings** when disposable income increases by one unit.
 
• 0 is the case where there is** no increase in consumer spending** with an increase in disposable income, which is highly unlikely.

questions.question: Consumers lose satisfaction in a product the more they consume it, this is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**decreasing marginal utility.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marginal utility** refers to the additional satisfaction or value that a consumer derives from consuming an additional unit of a product.
 
• **Decreasing marginal utility **means that as a consumer consumes more and more units of a product, the additional satisfaction or value derived from consuming each additional unit decreases.
 
• This happens because the consumer's needs and wants are limited, and as they consume **more of a product, **their needs and wants related to that product are increasingly satisfied, leading to a **decrease** in marginal utility.
 
• This concept is important for businesses to understand because it helps them determine the** optimal quantity of a product** to produce and sell, as well as the optimal price to charge for it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-satiation** refers to the concept that consumers always want **more of a good **and will never be fully satisfied.

 
 
• It is the **opposite **of decreasing marginal utility.
 
 
 
• **Increasing marginal utility** refers to the concept that as a consumer consumes** more units of a product,** the additional satisfaction or value derived from consuming each additional unit increases.
 
 
• This concept is **rare** and not commonly observed in real-world scenarios.

questions.question: If m, v and u, respectively, represent magnification, image distance and object distance, then the correct relation between m, v and u for a lens will be:

• **Magnification **is the ratio of the size of the image to the size of the object.
 
• It is a **dimensionless** quantity.

• It is measured in** meters.**
 
• **Object distance** (u) is the distance between the lens and the object being viewed.
 
• It is also measured in** meters.**
 
• The correct relation between m, v, and u for a lens is given by the formula** ****m = v/u. **
 
• This means that magnification is **directly proportional** to the object distance and inversely proportional to the image distance.

• If the image is** upright and virtual**, magnification is **positive.**
 
• If the image is **inverted and real,** magnification is **negative.**
 
• The** focal length of a lens** is the distance between the lens and the point at which the light rays converge or diverge.
 
• It is denoted by the symbol **f.**
 
• The formula for the focal length of a lens is given by** 1/f = 1/v - 1/u.**
